selected_evidence.summary: Shows the identities, inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership, 2750 directory modes, 0640 file modes, and functional access tests.
Both files retain identical pre-change, post-change, and post-restart SHA-256 hashes.
CentOS 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 are unchanged; no software was installed or upgraded.

Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, running system state, no failed units, persisted identities and permissions, successful access tests, and unchanged data hashes.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
uname -r
id inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers
printf '%s\n' '--- target ---'
stat -c '%n|type=%F|owner=%U:%G|mode=%a|size=%s' /srv/inventory
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y|%U:%G|%m|%s|%p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- ACLs ---'
if command -v getfacl >/dev/null 2>&1; then getfacl -R -p /srv/inventory; else printf '%s\n' 'getfacl unavailable'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- content digest ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum
printf '%s\n' '--- related services ---'
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'inventory' || true

commands.command:
set -eu
groupadd --system inventory-readers
useradd --system --gid inventory-readers --home-dir /srv/inventory --shell /sbin/nologin --no-create-home inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers

set -eu
chown -R -h inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type d -exec chmod 2750 {} +
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec chmod 0640 {} +
printf '%s\n' 'permission repair applied'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y|%U:%G|%m|%s|%p\n' | sort

set -eu
reader_gid=$(getent group inventory-readers | cut -d: -f3)
other_uid=$(id -u nobody)
other_gid=$(id -g nobody)
printf '%s\n' '--- owner access ---'
setpriv --reuid=$(id -u inventorysvc) --regid="$reader_gid" --clear-groups sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -w /srv/inventory/data/config.json && printf "owner_read_write=PASS\n"'
printf '%s\n' '--- reader-group access ---'
setpriv --reuid="$other_uid" --regid="$reader_gid" --clear-groups sh -c 'test -x /srv/inventory && test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv && ! test -w /srv/inventory/data/config.json && printf "reader_read_only=PASS\n"'
printf '%s\n' '--- other-user denial ---'
setpriv --reuid="$other_uid" --regid="$other_gid" --clear-groups sh -c '! test -x /srv/inventory && ! test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && ! test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv && printf "other_denied=PASS\n"'
printf '%s\n' '--- metadata and ACL indicator ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -exec ls -ldZ {} \;
printf '%s\n' '--- content digest ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum
